editing_instruction: Change one later statement about a named character's established family relationship or personal fact so it directly conflicts with an explicit earlier statement. Preserve the earlier statement. Do not use a revelation, mistaken belief, or change over time to explain it.
Change one later explicit fact about a named character or relationship to contradict an earlier explicit fact about that same person. Preserve the earlier fact; do not explain away the conflict.

Alter one later time or event-order statement to make the established sequence impossible. Keep the earlier explicit time or ordering statement intact; avoid flashbacks, clock errors or unexplained ambiguity.
Alter one later timestamp or order-of-events statement to contradict a clear earlier timing constraint. Preserve that earlier constraint. Do not change other events or explain the conflict.

Change one later location statement so the same person is somewhere incompatible with an earlier explicit location or movement constraint at that time. Preserve the earlier constraint; do not add a journey or time skip.

Change one later location or route statement to conflict directly with an earlier explicit spatial or access constraint. Preserve the earlier statement and surrounding movement; do not add secret routes or reopen a closed route.

Change one later statement about a uniquely identified object's possession or fixed physical property to contradict an earlier explicit fact. Preserve the earlier fact; do not introduce a duplicate, transfer, repair or transformation.

Change one later statement about the same uniquely identified keepsake's physical property or possession to conflict with an earlier explicit fact. Preserve that fact; do not add duplicates, exchanges or physical changes.
Change one later event to violate one explicit universal rule of the lantern magic stated earlier. Preserve that rule; do not add an exception, new power, unreliable narration or explanation.
Change one later event so the technology violates an explicit operating rule established earlier. Preserve the rule; do not add an override, malfunction, exception or new mechanism.
